features.name: area_zero_or_placeholder_flag
features.description: 1 when area_sqm is zero or less, marking a likely placeholder or unusable size entry; 0 otherwise.
features.expected_model_benefit: Lets trees separate zero-size records before applying size and density splits.

features.name: area_size_bucket
features.description: Ordinal bucket from training-fold area_sqm scale: 0 at or below 42.1211, 1 up to 69.7701, 2 up to 97.4192, 3 above.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides direct coarse size cuts that a tree can use without searching only on raw continuous values.

features.name: room_count_bucket
features.description: Ordinal room bucket: 0 for one-room, 1 for two-room, 2 for three-room, 3 for four or more based on half-step thresholds.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes common dwelling layout groups with stable split points.

features.name: area_per_room_sqm
features.description: Living area per room with rooms clipped below at 1 to avoid division issues.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures spaciousness interaction between room count and size.

features.name: space_per_room_bucket
features.description: Ordinal spaciousness per room: 0 at or below 20 sqm, 1 up to 35 sqm, 2 up to 50 sqm, 3 above 50 sqm.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives trees a ready compact-to-spacious interaction feature with intuitive cut points.
features.formula: np.where((area_sqm / np.maximum(rooms, 1.0)) <= 20.0, 0, np.where((area_sqm / np.maximum(rooms, 1.0)) <= 35.0, 1, np.where((area_sqm / np.maximum(rooms, 1.0)) <= 50.0, 2, 3)))

features.name: room_area_mismatch_flag
features.description: 1 when room count and area form an atypical layout: at least 3 rooms with at most 55 sqm or one room with at least 75 sqm.
features.expected_model_benefit: Isolates unusual layouts that may behave differently from ordinary room-area combinations.

features.name: floor_position_bucket
features.description: Buckets floor value into below-grade or special, low-rise, mid-rise, upper, high, and very high bands using domain and training-fold cut points.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures step changes from access, views, or floor-code effects that tree splits can reuse.

features.name: scrape_time_bucket
features.description: Ordinal bucket for scraped_at using training-fold chronology scale: 0 early or lower, 1 lower-mid, 2 upper-mid, 3 late or upper.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures batch or time-period shifts as a split-friendly ordinal feature.

features.name: location_code_bucket
features.description: Buckets location numeric value using training-fold mean and one-standard-deviation cut points.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups geography codes into broad bands so trees can learn coarse location effects with fewer cuts.

features.name: title_code_bucket
features.description: Buckets title numeric value using training-fold mean and one-standard-deviation cut points; treats the field as an encoded title or title-length signal.
features.expected_model_benefit: Condenses high-cardinality or length-like title signal into a small ordinal set for direct tree splits.

features.name: location_semantic_appeal_tier
features.description: Ordinal semantic score from the row's location value plus training-fold location codebook or name: 0 unknown or remote wording, 1 peripheral wording, 2 ordinary urban wording, 3 well-connected or amenity-rich wording, 4 central or landmark-proximate wording. Assign without sale or asking amounts.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies compact, human-readable geography context that tree splits can combine with room and area features.

features.name: title_semantic_quality_tier
features.description: Ordinal semantic score from the row's title value plus training-fold title codebook or text: 0 missing or vague wording, 1 generic property wording, 2 clear property type or condition, 3 renovation, new-building, furnishing, or amenity wording, 4 multiple strong quality or amenity cues. Assign without sale or asking amounts.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts title wording into a small ordinal feature so trees can split on presentation and amenity cues.
